candidate.frozen_unchanged: internal/core, internal/py, conformance/cases; main and installed preview untouched

mechanism: one ledger lock (<db>.lock, flock) taken BEFORE opening the ledger and held for the whole operation by every writer: run pass, deadline callback (incl. settlement/failure/re-arm), outside-check escalation, timeout-ack, decide, dispatch, claim. Fresh state per operation; core transition, package record and effects inside one critical section; no step_at comparison. No nesting (Tick escalates on its own locked view). Bounded waits (run/CLI 60 s, callback 120 s, check 30 s) -> E_LEDGER_BUSY; a callback that cannot lock tells duty the exact rerun command. MarkTimedOut/SettleTimeoutFailure key on the core's current action.

requirements.all_writers: covered by the lock at their CLI/process entry (runRun, runTimerCallback, runTimeoutAck, runDecide, runDispatch, runClaim) and liveness Check (withTimeouts); read-only status/expose not locked
requirements.consistency: the critical section spans core transition + package save + effect sends; the core's existing intent/effect keys (stop/wake intended -> delivered) still govern crash replay; no E_STALE rollback path is needed because no stale write can start
requirements.deadlock_bounded: one acquisition per process operation, no nesting; LOCK_NB polling with a bounded wait; transport sends inside the lock are bounded by the wake timeout (30 s each)
requirements.races: evidence/writer-safety/race-callback-vs-run.txt (real processes, pipe barrier): baseline changed-mode loses the timeout (final blocked, timeout null); candidate serializes (callback waits >3 s) and keeps it; same-mode kept on both. Go: TestRunAndCheckerNeverDoubleEscalateOrLoseAnAck (real passes), TestLedgerLockIsExclusiveAndBounded, TestMarkTimedOutOnlyForTheCoresCurrentAction

evidence.mutation: evidence/writer-safety/mutate-go.txt 113/113 (2 new; the stale-view Tick mutant removed because Tick no longer has its own escalation lock path; the core-interrupt mutant re-anchored)
regressions_on_release: evidence/writer-safety/cli-stopped-noack.txt (stopped quiet, duty +60 s, director +120 s, no incident)

host_effects: 4 unit-file timer runs p12test-cadence-* in ~/.config/systemd/user with 18 real daemon-reloads total; files and units removed (0 left)
no seats, main, install or clock change
residuals: Reload storm: a daemon-reload less than 45 s apart restarts the liveness timer's first OnActiveSec countdown (measured: 0 checks in 300 s with 20 s reloads); after the first firing, 60 s reloads did not move it. Not fixed here (unit template unchanged).

A writer holding the lock during a stalled transport delays others by up to 30 s per send; a callback waits at most 120 s, then tells duty the rerun command (the deadline is then not settled until rerun).
Checker own-supervision and systemwide failure: if run and the liveness timer are both down, nothing escalates (qualification limit).
Read-only status/expose are not locked and may show a state mid-operation.
L4a/L4b, live ack latency, L6b cadence on real seats: live run only.
